methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch for Exclaimer (exclaimer.com/pricing/), WiseStamp (wisestamp.com/pricing/), Newoldstamp (newoldstamp.com/pricing/), Letsignit (letsignit.com/pricing + letsignit.com/security-compliance), Rocketseed (rocketseed.com/email-signature-generator/pricing/), Opensense (opensense.com/pricing/ + opensense.com/security/), and BulkSignature (bulksignature.com/pricing). CodeTwo's pricing page returned HTTP 403; pricing corroborated from the Capterra listing citing $1.36/user/month for the 10-user minimum. MySignature's pricing page is JavaScript-dependent and did not render; pricing fields are corroborated from Capterra and GetApp current (2026) listings and carry lower confidence — aggregators conflict between a $4/user/month team rate and flat individual Pro ($12) / Pro Plus ($18) plans. Annual prices are shown as monthly equivalents and noted as billed annually. Custom/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Newoldstamp
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified from newoldstamp.com/pricing/. Single slider-based plan priced per signature/user. $1.80/signature/month is the ENTRY rate at the 5-signature minimum; the displayed '$109 billed annually' is the ANNUAL TOTAL for 5 signatures (5 x $1.80 x 12 = ~$108), NOT a monthly cost for 200 signatures. The prior draft note inverting this (claiming $1.80 'at scale' and '200 signatures = $109/month') was incorrect and is corrected. Per-signature rate decreases at higher slider volumes; 200+ signatures requires a custom quote. No HIPAA/SOC 2/GDPR certifications stated on any accessible page.

plans.notes: Per signature/user per month, billed annually. Slider-based, minimum 5 signatures. $1.80/signature/month is the entry rate at 5 signatures (= ~$109 annual total for 5 signatures). Per-signature rate decreases at higher volumes. Monthly billing available at a higher rate. 7-day free trial (signatures non-functional until upgrade). Custom plan for 200+ signatures.
